name: Bonsai 2 first completion
command: P=luigi@spark; ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o ServerAliveCountMax=20 $P 'curl -s -m 1800 http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1/chat/completions -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Explain what a neural network is in two sentences.\"}],\"max_tokens\":2048,\"temperature\":0.5,\"stream\":false}" > /tmp/b2ans1.json 2>/tmp/b2ans1.err; echo "curl_rc=$?"; wc -c /tmp/b2ans1.json' 2>&1 | tail -3
description: First Bonsai 2 27B completion via server (CPU-only, medium reasoning)
